pages.en: The family is at the airport. They are flying to Spain for their holiday. But Mum can't find her passport! "Oh no!" she says.
pages.zh: 一家人在机场。他们要坐飞机去西班牙度假。可是妈妈找不到她的护照了！“哎呀！”她说。
pages.scene: A bright busy airport, the family with suitcases, Mum looking worried and searching in her handbag, Lily and Tom watching.

pages.en: Everyone looks in the bags and the suitcases. Lily checks Mum's coat. Tom looks under the seats. There is no passport.
pages.zh: 大家在包和行李箱里找。Lily 检查妈妈的外套，Tom 往座位底下看。都没有护照。
pages.scene: An airport waiting area, Lily checking the pockets of a coat, Tom on his knees looking under a row of seats, Dad opening a suitcase.

pages.en: Then Max's bag moves. Tom opens it, and there is the passport, under Max's toy! Everyone laughs. "Now we can go!" says Dad.
pages.zh: 这时 Max 的包动了一下。Tom 打开一看，护照就在 Max 的玩具下面！大家都笑了。“现在我们可以走了！”爸爸说。
pages.scene: Tom holding up a passport (no writing) and laughing, a dog toy in his other hand, Mum, Dad and Lily laughing with relief at the airport.

questions.q: The family is going to Spain.
